meta.title: AQA GCSE English Language Mock Paper Bank
meta.subtitle: Original AQA-style GCSE English Language practice papers with secure OpenAI-assisted marking
notes: All sources, extracts and questions are original mock materials and are not official AQA papers.
Each generated paper contains four questions worth 4, 8, 20 and 40 marks and is designed for 1 hour 25 minutes.
The browser saves the selected paper pack and student responses locally on that device.

questions.instructionsTop: Focus this part of your answer on the second half of the source.
questions.statement: A student said, "Mara seems frightened at first, but by the end of the source she seems drawn towards the harbour."
questions.questionText: To what extent do you agree? In your response, you could: write about your own impressions of the character or setting; evaluate how the writer has created these impressions; support your ideas with references from the text.

rubric.name: AO4 evaluation
rubric.notes: Reward a clear, critical response to the statement with judgements supported by apt textual references and explanation of methods.
